verdict.rationale: CockroachDB documents multi-region capabilities with configurable table locality and survival goals that control how data is placed across regions, and its cloud-agnostic design lets users deploy wherever they choose. Community users explicitly tie the multi-region feature to data residency, noting it was historically gated behind enterprise licensing. Missing for 10: explicit docs on pinning data to a specific region for residency or compliance (e.g., row-level domiciling), documented region selection when creating a CockroachDB Cloud cluster, and independent hands-on confirmation that residency controls work as described.
